title: Claude for Small Business: 15 Agents That Run Your Ops
description:
Comment BUSINESS and I’ll send you the link.

Anthropic just dropped Claude for Small Business, 15 agentic workflows and 15 skills built around the tasks that drain owners every week. Connect QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Google Workspace, then ask in plain English to plan payroll, close the month, launch a campaign, and the agent reconciles cash, builds a 30-day forecast, drafts invoice reminders. Nothing touching money ships without your approval. Plus a free course on embedding AI into small business ops.

#Anthropic #ClaudeAI #SmallBusiness #AIagents #aitools
